profiler.finalization_authority: finalizeActiveCapture (single function; both MAX_DURATION backstop timer AND test seam call it; production seam path performs Profiler.stop BEFORE disconnect; gated on profilerRunning boolean so horizon path AND independent backstop can NEVER issue phantom Profiler.stop)
profiler.sampling_authority: explicit profilerRunning boolean — set true after every successful Profiler.start, set false after every Profiler.stop; complementary signal (not load-bearing for stop issuance)
profiler.in_flight_lock: finalizing boolean — set true at finalizeActiveCapture entry; rotate() aborts if finalizing=true (no Profiler.start racing with finalizer's stop)
profiler.in_flight_stop_authority: stopInFlight boolean + inFlightStopPromise — set true synchronously BEFORE every await session.post('Profiler.stop') and false synchronously AFTER; the ONLY load-bearing gate that guarantees 'at most one Profiler.stop may be outstanding'; concurrent finalizer awaits inFlightStopPromise instead of posting duplicate (per ACT INFLIGHT-STOP-CORRECTION04 P0)
profiler.rotation_completion_authority: rotationSettled Promise resolved only when rotate() body fully settles (persist, counter updates, disconnected-aware post-rotation Profiler.start); finalizer's deferred path awaits it before cleanup+meta so meta writes observe rotation's final _perf state (per ACT INFLIGHT-STOP-CORRECTION04 P0)
profiler.disconnected_guard: disconnected boolean set in cleanup(); rotate() post-rotation Profiler.start guarded by 'if (disconnected) return false' — prevents NPE on disconnected session when finalizer ran concurrently with rotate()'s in-flight stop (per ACT INFLIGHT-STOP-CORRECTION04 P0)
